items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I remember hearing that on the radio when I was young in the sixties. Rolf Harris. And actually I toured with Rolf Harris once.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean when we think of Australian music we probably think of, you know novelty songs, “Tie Me Kangaroo Down, Sport.”
Yeah, well, at one time that was true. I remember hearing that on the radio when I was young in the sixties. Rolf Harris. And actually I toured with Rolf Harris once.
No kidding? That’s a bit of trivia.
